notes: Read prior attempts before experimenting; did not repeat their explicit-switch or delayed-initialization hypotheses.
register-object, register-context-object, and register-locals add only register storage-class hints; they are codegen-neutral.
Coalesce labels encode reuse of message for source, kind for object_model, kind for flags, then phase for the named later value. All reused values have disjoint lifetimes.
phase-reuse labels test individual later variables on the best coalesce-101-none candidate.
inequality-operands reverses object_flag != source_flag after their side-effecting calls have completed.
One initial reuse-message draft failed C89 declaration placement; assignment was moved below the existing declarations before measuring the candidate.

Trial objdiff paths in commands were transient. Trial summaries and instruction differences are derived measurements, not raw objdiff output. Only the final complete canonical and strict raw outputs are retained.
